title: Goal Trees
description: Decomposes a lofty goal into sub-goals, then into tasks, forming a tree where every leaf is actionable. Goal trees make 'launch the product' executable by turning it into hundreds of small, ownable pieces.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Work Breakdown Structures
description: Organizes all project work into a hierarchical WBS where each level sums to its parent - 100% of the work, nothing missing, nothing double-counted. The WBS is the scope contract: if it is not in the WBS, it is not in the project.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Dependency DAGs
description: Maps task dependencies as a directed acyclic graph, revealing the true order of work and what can run in parallel. The DAG exposes the critical path - the sequence that determines the earliest finish.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Critical Path
description: Identifies the longest dependency chain - the critical path - which sets the minimum project duration. Managing the critical path means protecting those tasks fiercely, since any slip delays everything.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Milestone Rollups
description: Aggregates leaf-task progress into milestone status, giving leadership a true picture without micromanaging tasks. Rollups are honest only if leaf estimates are honest - garbage in, gospel out does not work.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Subtask Estimation
description: Estimates at the leaf-task level where uncertainty is smallest, then sums upward - far more accurate than guessing the whole. Small pieces are estimable; big blobs are not.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Recursive Planning
description: Plans in waves - detail now, coarse later - re-planning each wave as reality clarifies. Recursive planning accepts that far-future detail is fiction and plans accordingly.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: AND-OR Task Graphs
description: Models tasks with AND nodes (all children needed) and OR nodes (any child suffices), capturing real-world flexibility. AND-OR graphs plan for alternatives instead of single fragile paths.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Resource Leveling
description: Reschedules tasks so resource demand never exceeds supply - no person triple-booked in one week. Leveling trades theoretical speed for feasible plans that humans can actually execute.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Plan Validation
description: Checks plans for consistency - no cycles, estimates sum correctly, dependencies satisfiable - before execution begins. Validation catches the planning errors that become expensive mid-project.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Replanning Triggers
description: Defines explicit conditions that force a replan - 20% overrun, lost dependency, scope change - so replanning happens deliberately. Triggers prevent both plan-worship and plan-abandonment.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Task Templates
description: Provides templates for recurring work - 'ship a service', 'run an incident review' - with task lists refined from experience. Templates make the tenth time as good as the first.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Progress Rollups
description: Rolls leaf progress into portfolio views with drill-down, so executives see health and managers see detail. Good rollups are fractal: every level tells the truth.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Risk-Annotated Nodes
description: Annotates plan nodes with risks - probability, impact, mitigation - so the plan carries its dangers visibly. Annotated risks get managed; hidden ones become incidents.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Completion Criteria
description: Defines done for every task - tests passing, docs merged, demo shown - so 'done' means done. Criteria end the 90%-done-forever syndrome.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.
